## Overview

Inline single-date calendar behavior. Programmatic model writes never emit `dateChangeCommitted`.

- **Kind:** Directive
- **Export as:** `qzDatePicker`
- **Source:** [packages/primitives/src/date-picker/date-picker.directive.ts:38](https://github.com/Andersseen/quartz/blob/main/packages/primitives/src/date-picker/date-picker.directive.ts#L38)
